notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.content:
We have just released a new version of the game, fine tuning a few areas of the game, adding some bug fixes and generally improving the overall gameplay and feel of the game.

We also upgraded the unity edition of the game and altered the scoreboard levels slightly.

notes.title: Version 1.0 Live
notes.content:
Ta Daaa....

Version 1.0 is now live on steam and the store page is live so anyone may purchase a copy of Shmup Love Boom and enjoy the frantic bullet hell action that we have developed.

Big thanks go to the Kickstarter supporters who believed in the game and allowed us to make this game.
